helpMessage:
🤖 *{{storeUpper}} HELP*

Hi there! Here are the commands you can use:

• */buy* : View catalog & start buying The Hive cosmetics
• */buy <1-7>* : Directly open category catalog (e.g. */buy 2*)
• */katalog* : View complete catalog posters for all categories
• */status* : Check your active order status (or */status <ID>*)
• */history* : View your recent order history
• */faq* : FAQ about QRIS payment & item delivery
• */language <id|en>* : Switch language preference
• */support* / */cs* : Request direct live chat support with admin
• *c* / *cancel* : Cancel ongoing order flow
• *b* / *back* : Go back 1 step during ordering

👤 Need direct support from admin? Ask our admin team in the store group or type */support* or */cs*!
helpAdminSection:
🛠️ *ADMIN ONLY COMMANDS:*
• */admin* : Open admin status & control panel
• */balance* / */saldo* : Check The Hive bot token balance & today's sales summary
• */sync* / */synccatalog* : Synchronize catalog items from The Hive into database
• */reprocess* : Reprocess token-held / failed orders
• */reprocess <ID>* : Reprocess a specific order
• */setgroup [admin|log]* : Register chat group as Admin or Log Group
• */setdiscount <0-90>* : Set global store discount percentage
• */voucher* : Manage promo voucher codes (list/create/delete)
faqMessage:
💬 *FAQ & PAYMENT INFO — {{storeUpper}}*

*1. What payment methods are accepted?*
You can pay via *QRIS*! Supports all Indonesian e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay) & Mobile Banking (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, etc.) 📱

*2. Why is there a 3-digit unique code in the total?*
The 3-digit code allows our system to *automatically verify your payment in seconds* without uploading transfer receipts! Please transfer the exact amount including the last 3 digits ✨

*3. How is the item delivered?*
Items are gifted 100% officially via *The Hive In-Game Gift* feature directly to your Minecraft Bedrock Gamertag 🎁

*4. How long does delivery take?*
Once payment is detected, our bot delivers your gift within *1 - 3 minutes* ⚡

Any questions? Contact our store admin team or type */support* or */cs* 😊
